en.headline: Free dental check-ups for kindergarten children start on 1 September
en.dek: The Department of Health’s new Outreach Oral Health Programme will send professional teams to schools for annual screenings and fluoride treatment; more than 70 per cent of kindergartens have already joined.
body: The Department of Health announced on Monday that the Outreach Oral Health Programme for Pre-school Children will begin on 1 September, providing free on-campus oral screenings and preventive care to eligible kindergarten pupils.

Children aged 32 months or older attending participating kindergartens may receive the service once a year. Teams from 23 designated providers will cover all 18 districts, offering risk assessments, fluoride application where needed, individual health reports for parents, and oral-health talks for teachers. As of mid-August, 680 of 949 kindergartens, or about 71.7 per cent, had signed up; the department expected tens of thousands of children to benefit.

Consultant in charge of the dental service Dr Kitty Hse said the ages of three to six are crucial for protecting milk teeth and that school-based checks help reduce anxiety. The programme extends free or subsidised preventive dental services across all age groups.

zh.headline: 學前兒童口腔健康外展計劃9月1日推出 七成幼稚園已參與
zh.dek: 衞生署新計劃將派出牙科團隊到校為幼稚園學童提供免費口腔檢查及預防服務，目前已有逾七成幼稚園報名。
body: 衞生署周一公布，「學前兒童口腔健康外展計劃」將於9月1日推出，由政府指定服務機構派出牙科專業團隊到幼稚園，為合資格學童提供免費在地口腔檢查及預防性牙科服務。
年滿32個月或以上、就讀參與計劃幼稚園的學童每年可獲一次服務。目前共有23間服務機構覆蓋全港18區，會按需要塗氟、向家長提供口腔健康報告及護理建議，並為教職員舉辦講座。截至8月中，全港949間幼稚園中已有680間（約71.7%）同意參與，預計數以萬計學童受惠。
牙科服務顧問醫生許美賢表示，三至六歲是保護乳齒的關鍵時期，到校檢查有助減低幼兒焦慮。計劃令免費或資助預防性牙科服務覆蓋所有年齡組別。
